```{r}
# =========================================================
# Distance-to-land-cover rasters from ESA CCI / C3S LCCS data
#
# All years (2008-2020) are now .nc files, pre-cropped to the same
# extent, with the land cover band named "lccs_class" in every file.
#
# All output rasters are:
#   - cropped/aligned to a common extent
#   - resampled to ~500 m resolution
#   - kept in EPSG:4326 (matching the rest of the SSF covariates)
#
# Approach: for each land cover "group" (e.g. cropland), reclassify
# the LC raster so cells matching that group's values = 1 and all
# other cells = NA, then use terra::distance() to compute, for every
# cell, the distance to the nearest cell belonging to that group.
# Distance is computed at native (300 m) resolution first, then the
# resulting continuous distance surface is resampled to the common
# 500 m grid -- this is more accurate than downsampling the categorical
# land cover first.
#
# NOTE: your source files are already clipped exactly to common_ext,
# with no margin beyond it. That means there is no buffer available
# for the distance calculation -- cells right at the edge of your
# study area may look slightly farther from a class than they truly
# are, if that class exists just outside the box but wasn't
# downloaded. If you can re-request the files with ~0.5 deg of padding
# on each side in the future, set buffer_deg below to take advantage
# of it; for now it's 0 to match what you actually have.
# =========================================================

library(terra)

# Give terra more RAM headroom and show progress bars on slow steps.
# Default memfrac is 0.6 (60% of available RAM) -- bump it up a bit.
terraOptions(memfrac = 0.9, progress = 1)

# -----------------------------
# 1. USER CONFIGURATION
# -----------------------------

# Folder containing the .nc files
data_dir <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/ESACCI_LCCS"          # <-- EDIT ME

# Folder to write the distance-to rasters
out_dir <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/ESACCI_LCCS/landcover_distance"      # <-- EDIT ME
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Common study area extent: xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax
common_ext <- ext(12.5, 25.5, -21.5, -16.5)
common_crs <- "EPSG:4326"

# Target output resolution, in meters (approximate -- see note in
# build_template() below)
target_res_m <- 500

# OPTIONAL (recommended): path to an existing 500 m EPSG:4326 raster that
# your other SSF covariates (e.g. from GEE) already use. If provided, the
# distance rasters are resampled to align EXACTLY with it, so every
# covariate shares one common grid. Leave as NULL to instead build a fresh
# ~500 m grid from scratch over common_ext.
template_file <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/500m_data/terrain_rast_500m.tif"

# Buffer (in degrees) added around common_ext before computing distances.
# Set to 0 -- your source files are already clipped to common_ext exactly,
# so there is no extra margin to crop from. See note at the top of the
# script if you're able to re-download with padding in the future.
buffer_deg <- 0

# -----------------------------
# 2. LAND COVER GROUPS (THE ADJUSTABLE PART)
# -----------------------------
# Each entry = the NB_LAB codes (from ESACCI-LC-Legend.csv) that should
# count as "present" for that distance-to raster. Add, remove, split,
# or merge classes freely -- nothing else in the script needs to change.
# Defaults below are a reasonable starting point based on the legend.

lc_groups <- list(
  cropland   = c(10, 12, 20, 30, 40),
  tree_cover = c(50, 60, 61, 62, 70, 71, 72, 80, 81, 82, 90,
                 100, 160, 170),
  shrubland  = c(120, 121, 122, 180),
  grassland  = c(110, 130),
  urban      = c(190),
  water      = c(210)
)

# -----------------------------
# 3. FILE NAMING (EDIT IF YOUR FILENAMES DIFFER)
# -----------------------------
# 2008-2015 and 2016-2020 use different prefixes/version tags, but both
# are .nc files with the land cover band named "lccs_class".

years_v207 <- 2008:2015   # ESACCI-LC ... v2.0.7cds ...
years_v211 <- 2016:2020   # C3S-LC ... v2.1.1 ...

nc_path <- function(year) {
  if (year %in% years_v207) {
    file.path(data_dir,
      sprintf("ESACCI-LC-L4-LCCS-Map-300m-P1Y-%d-v2.0.7cds.area-subset.-16.5.25.5.-21.5.12.5.nc",
              year))
  } else if (year %in% years_v211) {
    file.path(data_dir,
      sprintf("C3S-LC-L4-LCCS-Map-300m-P1Y-%d-v2.1.1.area-subset.-16.5.25.5.-21.5.12.5.nc",
              year))
  } else {
    stop("Year ", year, " is not listed in years_v207 or years_v211")
  }
}

# -----------------------------
# 4. HELPER FUNCTIONS
# -----------------------------

# Read the land cover raster for a given year
read_lc_raster <- function(year) {
  f <- nc_path(year)
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("File not found: ", f)
  # nc files hold several variables -- pull out just the land cover band
  rast(f, subds = "lccs_class")
}

# Build (or load) the common output grid that every distance raster will
# be resampled onto
build_template <- function() {
  if (!is.null(template_file)) {
    if (!file.exists(template_file)) {
      stop("Template file not found: ", template_file)
    }
    tmpl <- rast(template_file)
    if (!same.crs(tmpl, common_crs)) {
      warning("Template raster CRS is not EPSG:4326 -- reprojecting template.")
      tmpl <- project(tmpl, common_crs)
    }
  } else {
    # ~111,320 m per degree at the equator. This is an approximation --
    # exact "500 m" cells aren't possible on a lon/lat grid since a degree
    # of longitude shrinks toward the poles. Fine for a ~5 degree latitude
    # band like this one; for exact alignment with your other 500 m GEE
    # covariates, set template_file above instead.
    res_deg <- target_res_m / 111320
    tmpl <- rast(ext = common_ext, resolution = res_deg, crs = common_crs)
  }
  tmpl
}

target_template <- build_template()

buffered_ext <- ext(common_ext[1] - buffer_deg, common_ext[2] + buffer_deg,
                     common_ext[3] - buffer_deg, common_ext[4] + buffer_deg)

# Build a "distance to <group>" raster for one year, on the common grid
make_distance_raster <- function(lc_raster_buffered, values, group_name, year) {
  # Reclassify: cells matching 'values' -> 1, everything else -> NA
  rcl <- matrix(c(values, rep(1, length(values))), ncol = 2)
  target <- classify(lc_raster_buffered, rcl = rcl, others = NA)

  # distance() gives, per cell, the distance to the nearest non-NA cell.
  # For geographic (lon/lat) rasters, terra computes this as geodesic
  # distance in meters automatically.
  dist_r <- distance(target)

  # Crop away the buffer (a no-op when buffer_deg = 0)
  dist_r <- crop(dist_r, common_ext)

  # Resample (bilinear, since this is now a continuous surface) onto the
  # common 500 m grid so it aligns with your other SSF covariates
  dist_r <- resample(dist_r, target_template, method = "bilinear")

  names(dist_r) <- paste0("dist_", group_name, "_", year)
  dist_r
}

# -----------------------------
# 5. MAIN LOOP
# -----------------------------

all_years <- c(years_v207, years_v211)

for (yr in all_years) {

  message("Processing year ", yr, " ...")
  lc <- read_lc_raster(yr)

  # Crop to the (possibly buffered) extent -- reused across all groups
  lc <- crop(lc, buffered_ext)

  # Force fully into RAM once, instead of re-reading from disk per group
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  lc <- toMemory(lc)
  message("  Loaded into memory in ", round(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"), 1), " sec")

  for (grp in names(lc_groups)) {

    out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("dist_", grp, "_", yr, ".tif"))

    if (file.exists(out_file)) {
      message("  Skipping ", grp, " (already exists)")
      next
    }

    t1 <- Sys.time()
    message("  -> distance to ", grp, " ...")
    dist_r <- make_distance_raster(lc, lc_groups[[grp]], grp, yr)
    writeRaster(dist_r, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)
    message("     done in ", round(difftime(Sys.time(), t1, units = "mins"), 2), " min")
  }

  rm(lc)  # free memory before moving to next year
}

message("Done. Distance rasters written to: ", out_dir)
```

```{r}
# =========================================================
# Optimized Distance-to-land-cover rasters from ESA CCI / C3S LCCS data
# =========================================================
library(terra)

terraOptions(memfrac = 0.9, progress = 1)

# -----------------------------
# 1. USER CONFIGURATION
# -----------------------------
data_dir <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/ESACCI_LCCS"
out_dir  <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/ESACCI_LCCS/lc_dist_2"
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

common_ext   <- ext(12.5, 25.5, -21.5, -16.5)
common_crs   <- "EPSG:4326"
target_res_m <- 500
template_file <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/500m_data/terrain_rast_500m.tif"
buffer_deg   <- 0

# AUTOMATIC METRIC CRS SELECTION (UTM Zone 34S matches center of your coordinates)
# Distance calculations in UTM are massively faster than geodesic math in EPSG:4326
metric_crs   <- "EPSG:32734" 

# -----------------------------
# 2. LAND COVER GROUPS
# -----------------------------
lc_groups <- list(
  cropland   = c(10, 12, 20, 30, 40),
  tree_cover = c(50, 60, 61, 62, 70, 71, 72, 80, 81, 82, 90, 100, 160, 170),
  shrubland  = c(120, 121, 122, 180),
  grassland  = c(110, 130),
  urban      = c(190),
  water      = c(210)
)

# -----------------------------
# 3. FILE NAMING
# -----------------------------
years_v207 <- 2008:2015
years_v211 <- 2016:2020

nc_path <- function(year) {
  if (year %in% years_v207) {
    file.path(data_dir, sprintf("ESACCI-LC-L4-LCCS-Map-300m-P1Y-%d-v2.0.7cds.area-subset.-16.5.25.5.-21.5.12.5.nc", year))
  } else if (year %in% years_v211) {
    file.path(data_dir, sprintf("C3S-LC-L4-LCCS-Map-300m-P1Y-%d-v2.1.1.area-subset.-16.5.25.5.-21.5.12.5.nc", year))
  } else {
    stop("Year ", year, " is not listed.")
  }
}

# -----------------------------
# 4. HELPER FUNCTIONS
# -----------------------------
read_lc_raster <- function(year) {
  f <- nc_path(year)
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("File not found: ", f)
  rast(f, subds = "lccs_class")
}

build_template <- function() {
  if (!is.null(template_file)) {
    if (!file.exists(template_file)) stop("Template file not found: ", template_file)
    tmpl <- rast(template_file)
    if (!same.crs(tmpl, common_crs)) {
      warning("Template raster CRS is not EPSG:4326 -- reprojecting template.")
      tmpl <- project(tmpl, common_crs)
    }
  } else {
    res_deg <- target_res_m / 111320
    tmpl <- rast(ext = common_ext, resolution = res_deg, crs = common_crs)
  }
  tmpl
}

target_template <- build_template()
buffered_ext    <- ext(common_ext[1] - buffer_deg, common_ext[2] + buffer_deg, common_ext[3] - buffer_deg, common_ext[4] + buffer_deg)

make_distance_raster_fast <- function(lc_raster_metric, values, group_name, year) {
  # Reclassify on the metric grid
  rcl <- matrix(c(values, rep(1, length(values))), ncol = 2)
  target <- classify(lc_raster_metric, rcl = rcl, others = NA)
  
  # Fast flat metric distance evaluation
  dist_r_metric <- distance(target)
  
  # Project the high-res metric distance surface directly back to your EPSG:4326 template
  # This combines cropping, reprojection, and 500m resampling into one step!
  dist_r <- project(dist_r_metric, target_template, method = "bilinear")
  
  names(dist_r) <- paste0("dist_", group_name, "_", year)
  dist_r
}

# -----------------------------
# 5. MAIN LOOP
# -----------------------------
all_years <- c(years_v207, years_v211)

for (yr in all_years) {
  message("Processing year ", yr, " ...")
  lc <- read_lc_raster(yr)
  lc <- crop(lc, buffered_ext)
  
  # Project the categorical grid to Metric ONCE per year
  t0 <- Sys.time()
  lc_metric <- project(lc, metric_crs, method = "near")
  lc_metric <- toMemory(lc_metric)
  message(" Projected to metric and loaded to RAM in ", round(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"), 1), " sec")
  
  for (grp in names(lc_groups)) {
    out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("dist_", grp, "_", yr, ".tif"))
    if (file.exists(out_file)) {
      message(" Skipping ", grp, " (already exists)")
      next
    }
    
    t1 <- Sys.time()
    message(" -> distance to ", grp, " ...")
    dist_r <- make_distance_raster_fast(lc_metric, lc_groups[[grp]], grp, yr)
    writeRaster(dist_r, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)
    message(" done in ", round(difftime(Sys.time(), t1, units = "secs"), 2), " secs")
  }
  rm(lc_metric)
}

message("Done. Distance rasters written to: ", out_dir)

```
```{r}
# =========================================================
# Distance-to-water rasters (2008-2020), combining:
# (a) the static hydrorivers_Raster.tif (values 1, 2, 3 = river)
# (b) each year's ESA CCI / C3S LCCS land-cover water class (210)
# Output: one "dist_water_<year>.tif" per year, 500 m, EPSG:4326, aligned to your other SSF covariates via template_file.


library(terra)

terraOptions(memfrac = 0.9, progress = 1)

# -----------------------------
# 1. USER CONFIGURATION
# -----------------------------

# Folder containing the land cover .nc files
data_dir <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/ESACCI_LCCS"          # <-- EDIT ME

# Path to your static hydrorivers raster
hydro_file <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/Linear_features/hydrorivers_Raster_corrected.tif" 

# Folder to write the distance-to-water rasters
out_dir <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/ESACCI_LCCS"   # <-- EDIT ME
dir.create(out_dir, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# Common study area extent: xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax
common_ext <- ext(12.5, 25.5, -21.5, -16.5)
common_crs <- "EPSG:4326"

# Target output resolution, in meters (only used if template_file is NULL)
target_res_m <- 500

# Existing 500 m EPSG:4326 raster your other SSF covariates already use --
# everything gets resampled to align EXACTLY with this
template_file <- "~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/500m_data/terrain_rast_500m.tif"

# Buffer (in degrees) around common_ext before computing distances.
buffer_deg <- 0

# Metric CRS for fast, flat-plane distance math (UTM 34S -- matches the
# rest of your pipeline for this region)
metric_crs <- "EPSG:32734"

# Values that count as "water" in each source
hydro_river_values <- c(1, 2, 3)   # hydrorivers_Raster.tif
lc_water_value <- 210          # ESA CCI / C3S LCCS "water bodies" class

# -----------------------------
# 2. FILE NAMING (land cover .nc files)
# -----------------------------

years_v207 <- 2008:2015   # ESACCI-LC ... v2.0.7cds ...
years_v211 <- 2016:2020   # C3S-LC ... v2.1.1 ...

nc_path <- function(year) {
  if (year %in% years_v207) {
    file.path(data_dir,
      sprintf("ESACCI-LC-L4-LCCS-Map-300m-P1Y-%d-v2.0.7cds.area-subset.-16.5.25.5.-21.5.12.5.nc",
              year))
  } else if (year %in% years_v211) {
    file.path(data_dir,
      sprintf("C3S-LC-L4-LCCS-Map-300m-P1Y-%d-v2.1.1.area-subset.-16.5.25.5.-21.5.12.5.nc",
              year))
  } else {
    stop("Year ", year, " is not listed in years_v207 or years_v211")
  }
}

read_lc_raster <- function(year) {
  f <- nc_path(year)
  if (!file.exists(f)) stop("File not found: ", f)
  rast(f, subds = "lccs_class")
}

# -----------------------------
# 3. HELPER FUNCTIONS
# -----------------------------

build_template <- function() {
  if (!is.null(template_file)) {
    if (!file.exists(template_file)) stop("Template file not found: ", template_file)
    tmpl <- rast(template_file)
    if (!same.crs(tmpl, common_crs)) {
      warning("Template raster CRS is not EPSG:4326 -- reprojecting template.")
      tmpl <- project(tmpl, common_crs)
    }
  } else {
    res_deg <- target_res_m / 111320
    tmpl <- rast(ext = common_ext, resolution = res_deg, crs = common_crs)
  }
  tmpl
}

target_template <- build_template()

buffered_ext <- ext(common_ext[1] - buffer_deg, common_ext[2] + buffer_deg,
                     common_ext[3] - buffer_deg, common_ext[4] + buffer_deg)

# Reclassify a set of values to a 1/NA presence raster
to_presence <- function(r, values) {
  rcl <- matrix(c(values, rep(1, length(values))), ncol = 2)
  classify(r, rcl = rcl, others = NA)
}

# Project a lon/lat SpatExtent into another CRS (used to crop hydrorivers
# to the study area in its own native CRS before touching it further)
project_ext <- function(e, from_crs, to_crs) {
  v  <- as.polygons(e, crs = from_crs)
  vp <- project(v, to_crs)
  ext(vp)
}

# =========================================================
# 4. STATIC: distance-to-hydrorivers, computed ONCE
#    (identical every year, so this happens outside the year loop
#    and is cached to disk)
# =========================================================

dist_hydro_file <- file.path(out_dir, "dist_water_rivers.tif")

if (file.exists(dist_hydro_file)) {

  message("Loading cached distance-to-hydrorivers raster ...")
  dist_hydro_final <- rast(dist_hydro_file)

} else {

  message("Building distance-to-hydrorivers raster (one-time) ...")
  hydro_r <- rast(hydro_file)
  message("  hydrorivers_Raster.tif -> resolution: ",
          paste(signif(res(hydro_r), 6), collapse = " x "),
          " | CRS: ", crs(hydro_r, proj = TRUE))

  # Crop to the study area first, in the hydro raster's OWN crs, so we
  # never reproject more of it than necessary
  crop_ext_native <- project_ext(buffered_ext, common_crs, crs(hydro_r))
  hydro_r <- crop(hydro_r, crop_ext_native)

  hydro_bin <- to_presence(hydro_r, hydro_river_values)

  # Move to a metric CRS for fast distance math
  hydro_metric <- project(hydro_bin, metric_crs, method = "near")
  hydro_metric <- toMemory(hydro_metric)

  dist_hydro_metric <- distance(hydro_metric)

  # Straight onto the final 500 m EPSG:4326 template
  dist_hydro_final <- project(dist_hydro_metric, target_template, method = "bilinear")
  names(dist_hydro_final) <- "dist_hydrorivers"

  writeRaster(dist_hydro_final, dist_hydro_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  rm(hydro_r, hydro_bin, hydro_metric, dist_hydro_metric)
}

# =========================================================
# 5. PER YEAR: distance-to-water-landcover, combined with the
#    static distance-to-hydrorivers via a cell-wise minimum
# =========================================================

all_years <- c(years_v207, years_v211)

for (yr in all_years) {

  out_file <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("dist_water_", yr, ".tif"))
  if (file.exists(out_file)) {
    message("Skipping ", yr, " (already exists)")
    next
  }

  message("Processing year ", yr, " ...")
  lc <- read_lc_raster(yr)
  lc <- crop(lc, buffered_ext)

  t0 <- Sys.time()
  lc_metric <- project(lc, metric_crs, method = "near")
  lc_metric <- toMemory(lc_metric)
  message("  Projected to metric and loaded to RAM in ",
          round(difftime(Sys.time(), t0, units = "secs"), 1), " sec")

  lc_water_bin   <- to_presence(lc_metric, lc_water_value)
  dist_lc_metric <- distance(lc_water_bin)
  dist_lc_final  <- project(dist_lc_metric, target_template, method = "bilinear")

  # Cell-wise minimum = distance to the nearest EITHER source (river or
  # water-cover cell) -- mathematically the same as distance to their union
 combined <- min(dist_lc_final, dist_hydro_final, na.rm = TRUE)
  names(combined) <- paste0("dist_water_", yr)

  writeRaster(combined, out_file, overwrite = TRUE)
  message("  done -> ", out_file)

  rm(lc, lc_metric, lc_water_bin, dist_lc_metric, dist_lc_final, combined)
}

message("Done. Distance-to-water rasters written to: ", out_dir)
```

```{r}
library(terra)

# Allow GDAL to rebuild missing/corrupted .shx index files automatically
Sys.setenv(SHAPE_RESTORE_SHX = "YES")

#Settings
res_m <- 500
ext_ll <- c(xmin = 12.5, ymin = -21.5, xmax = 25.5, ymax = -16.5) # lon/lat extent
crs_ll <- "EPSG:4326"

# Recommended: work in a projected CRS so 500 really means 500 metres.
# UTM zone 33S covers Namibia/most of KAZA (EPSG:32733).
target_crs <- "EPSG:32733"

# Input/output setup
in_dir  <- path.expand("~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/Linear_features")
out_dir <- path.expand("~/Desktop/Arnhold/sparcle-hwc-old2/code/sparcle-hwc/data/Linear_features")

files <- c(
  "hydrorivers_namibia_gte5.shp",
  "KAZA_vet_fences_exported.shp",
  "roads_selected_exported.shp"
)

# Build the template raster once, in the projected CRS, so all three
# outputs align to the same grid 
ext_vec    <- vect(ext(ext_ll["xmin"], ext_ll["xmax"], ext_ll["ymin"], ext_ll["ymax"]), crs = crs_ll)
ext_proj   <- project(ext_vec, target_crs)
r_template <- rast(ext(ext_proj), resolution = res_m, crs = target_crs)

#Loop over the three files
for (f in files) {
  message("Processing: ", f)
  shp_path <- file.path(in_dir, f)
  lines <- vect(shp_path)
  
  # Reproject lines to match the template CRS 
  if (crs(lines) != crs(r_template)) {
    lines <- project(lines, crs(r_template))
  }
  
  #fix:  fun = "max" forces any cell touched by a line to strictly become 1
  r_out <- rasterize(lines, r_template, field = 1, background = 0, touches = TRUE, fun = "max")
  
  out_name <- paste0(tools::file_path_sans_ext(basename(f)), "_500m.tif")
  
  # fix: datatype = "INT1U" saves the output strictly as integers (0 and 1)
  writeRaster(r_out, file.path(out_dir, out_name), datatype = "INT1U", overwrite = TRUE)
  
  message(" -> wrote ", out_name)
}

message("Done.")
```


```
